entries.titleBn: MATHEMATICS: Trigonometric Ratios — সমাধান গাইড #1 (শ্রেণি 6)
formulas: sin^2(theta) + cos^2(theta) = 1 | 1 + tan^2(theta) = sec^2(theta)
stepsEn: Identify the core principle from Class 6 MATHEMATICS: Trigonometric Ratios.
Apply the standard NCTB relation: sin^2(theta) + cos^2(theta) = 1 | 1 + tan^2(theta) = sec^2(theta).
Substitute verified boundary values step by step while preserving units and precision.
Review board marking rubric and verify consistency against unit bounds.
